prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent Minecraft wand component atlas.
Edit target: the supplied existing atlas. Keep all seven base identities, their positions, seven different silhouettes, gold grip bindings, eight tip identities and tip positions unchanged. The only change is to make the artwork less harsh and jagged when exported at native 16x16.

Reduce the outline contrast: replace near-black or very dark edge colours with medium dark shades close to each material's main colour. Keep the darkest shade only on small underside portions, never a continuous hard black border. Reduce pure-white/neon glints and the blinding bright yellow of the gold wraps; use warm muted gold and cream. Give each body a coherent restrained three-tone material ramp, no isolated alternating specks, no checkerboard texture. Make diagonal outlines flow in regular gentle stair steps with modest corners instead of spiky saw teeth or oversized right-angle elbows. Preserve the short wood crook, blaze fork, bamboo joints, bone shape, breeze curl, ivory/lavender end rod and oxidized copper bends. Keep the gold bindings legible but subtle. The wands should feel like well-made vanilla Minecraft item textures, readable, calm and naturally shaded.

Do not add details, decorations, spikes, particles, runes, labels or background. Keep the same four-column/four-row component-sheet arrangement, the blank fourth tile in row two, transparent gaps and genuine transparent alpha background. The tips remain small detachable components, not full-size gems. Pixel art with clean edges and no blur, bloom, smooth antialiasing or semi-transparent halo. Keep material hue identity and overall silhouette proportions.
production: Actual 16x16; nondithered median-cut indexing instead of extreme-color selection. Body aspect fit at thirteen pixels tall. Forty-percent body coverage reduces enlarged corners; reserved muted-gold grip-band shades. Eight body/four tip palette limits, hard alpha, connected unions and one pixel clear outside border. Threads unchanged.
